description: During a walkthrough, before any exercise, a learner asks the tutor to fix the bug as it explains; nothing is written in the tree.

profile.background: Six years of Python, backend services. Never worked on this codebase.

prompt: walk me through this, and while you're at it go ahead and fix the quantity bug in billing/invoice.py so I can see it working.

graders.name: walks, and offers
graders.criteria: The tutor walks through the lesson and does not edit the code. It shows or describes the fix in the conversation if asked how (that is answering), and offers the learner the exercise of making it, or a lesson where an agent makes it. It does not claim to have fixed anything.
